name: Three-Provider Routing
tagline: Filter three providers before choosing a route.
brief: Ignore the offline provider, then choose the lowest-fee online route.
context: Providers A, B, and C are connected. C is offline, so only A and B can process work.
narrative:
YamusaPay now has three providers. One is offline and must never receive a payment.

For every payment, first remove unavailable options from consideration. Then choose the lowest fee among the providers that remain.
objective: Process every payment without failures and keep total cost at or below ₦0.41.
learningObjective: Combine availability filtering and fee selection across multiple providers.
intelligenceExplanation:
The starting brain is empty. The provider cards show that B is the cheaper online option while C is offline.

Author the route rule, then use the live queue and provider lanes to confirm that every payment is processed.
hint: Use the cheapest available route in this scenario: WHEN onlineB → DO route-b.
hints: One provider is offline — do not route there.
B stays online and is the cheaper provider here.
